project.title: Microplastic biofilms in year-long wastewater microcosm
project.description: 5 different microplastics incubated in activated aerobic wastewater (individual tube microcosm), taken from UK wastewater treatment plant, over the course of a year, and sampled at 1, 3, 6 and 12 month intervals.
project.center_name: Leibnitz Institute for Baltic Sea Resarch Warnemuende
